label: Reload
description: Watch the tree and serve it again when a document changes. Meant for development: a project names it in its startup list, before whatever listens, and an edit takes effect without a restart. It judges the tree the way `wilanis check` does and serves it only when it is clean, so a half-written document never becomes what answers.

debounceMs.description: how long to wait for the edits to stop before reloading, in milliseconds; default 120
